item.beyondsolo.purifying_draught.desc: Washes half the mana poisoning out and keeps a gate's thick mana out for a while. Lifts hexes too.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.dense.title: Thick Mana
notify.beyondsolo.mana.dense: The mana in this gate is thick enough to poison you. Rest by a purifying crystal to draw it out.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.sick.title: Mana Sickness
notify.beyondsolo.mana.sick: Foreign mana is seeping into you. Your blows are growing weaker.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.poisoned.title: Mana Poisoning
notify.beyondsolo.mana.poisoned: The mana is eating at you: weaker blows, heavier steps, and it bites at your health.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.collapse.title: Mana Collapse
notify.beyondsolo.mana.collapse: Your body can't hold any more. Rest by a purifying crystal, drink a draught or get out of the gate, now.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.burst.title: Mana Burst
notify.beyondsolo.mana.burst: The mana tore its way out of you.
notify.beyondsolo.mana.clean.title: Mana Cleared
notify.beyondsolo.mana.clean: The poisoning has left your body.
death.attack.beyondsolo.mana_poisoning: %1$s was torn apart by the mana inside them
death.attack.beyondsolo.mana_poisoning.p: %1$s was torn apart by the mana inside them while fighting %2$s
